about.heading: Welcome to your home away from home
about.text: We are a small family business that has been running since the 80's, offering world travellers a haven where they can feel at home. Experience true Cretan hospitality and feel the tranquility of our cozy environment, clean facilities and friendly personal assistance. Your comfort and relaxation is up to us… Just enjoy!

location.heading: Our dream location
location.text: Pension Mylos is all about panoramic views of the Mirabello Bay. We're on the perfect spot: very close to the beach, restaurants and coffee houses, and at the same time not too close, so there's total tranquility all day. Agios Nikolaos has very clean sea water, many beautiful beaches, and it's the ideal base for day trips across the whole Lasithi prefecture.

sights.name: Kitroplatia beach
sights.text: A very nice clean beach with coffee houses and traditional restaurants around, making sure you'll have everything at hand.

sights.name: Port
sights.text: The main port of Agios Nikolaos, with the statue of Europa's abduction and a large free parking space.

sights.name: Lake Voulismeni
sights.text: Traditional restaurants all around and a stunning view of the town and port from the upper side. The famous lake whose bottom even Jacques Cousteau couldn't find.

sights.name: Town centre
sights.text: A lively centre with coffee houses, all kinds of shops and a beautiful orthodox church.

sights.name: Ámmos beach
sights.text: A small sandy beach with tranquil waters and many places around for a snack and a drink.

sights.name: Ammoudi beach
sights.text: A large sandy beach with green waters, beach bars for a refreshing drink and restaurants with traditional cuisine.

sights.name: Almirós beach
sights.text: Clear waters and golden sand where the Almirós river meets the sea, with a nice little bar, toilets and very friendly service.

sights.name: Spinalonga & Elounda
sights.text: The seaside village of Elounda and the island of Spinalonga: Venetian fortress, winding alleys, and the story of one of Europe's last leper colonies.

sights.name: Chrissi Island, Ierapetra
sights.text: A day trip to an island that will make you wonder if you are in Crete or the Caribbean.

sights.name: Heraklion airport
sights.text: Nikos Kazantzakis airport, the largest in Crete and the busiest all year round.

sights.name: Cave of Zeus
sights.text: The glorious Cave of Zeus, authentic Cretan villages and the unspoiled nature of East Crete.

sights.name: Knossos Palace
sights.text: The world-famous archaeological site and the Heraklion Museum: 3,500 years of civilization.
